notes.title: Void Resurgence Update: Introducing Void Vagabond!
notes.content:
[p]🚀 [b]Attention Void Resurgence Pilots![/b][/p][p]We’ve added a brand-new, ultra-rare cosmic wanderer to the fray: the [b]Void Vagabond[/b]. Not quite a friend… not quite a foe… it’s the fastest object in the void, and catching it is a challenge worthy of legend!

👀 [b]What Is the Void Vagabond?[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Speed Demon:[/b] Zips around at breakneck pace—good luck keeping up![/p][/*][*][p][b]Elusive Appearance:[/b] It only shows up [b]three times[/b] over a standard 30-minute run.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]⏱ When It Appears[/b][/p][p]The Void Vagabond will spawn [b]randomly[/b] once within each of these time windows:[/p][list][*][p][b]25:00 → 17:30[/b] minutes remaining[/p][/*][*][p][b]17:30 → 10:00[/b] minutes remaining[/p][/*][*][p][b]10:00 → 2:30[/b] minutes remaining[/p][/*][/list][p][b]🎁 Why You’ll Want to Catch It[/b][/p][p]Bring it down and you’ll be handsomely rewarded. You might snag Core Systems level-ups and, in rare cases, even Crew members for crucial upgrades. It’s risk vs. reward at its finest—are you up for the hunt?[/p][p]
Gear up, keep your thrusters hot, and keep your eyes peeled. The Void Vagabond waits for no one… except the boldest pilots. Good luck out there!
[/p][p]– [i]The Void Resurgence Team[/i][/p]

notes.title: Void Resurgence Update: Introducing Layered Health Bars!
notes.content: [p]Hey Void Resurgence fans – we’ve got a cool new visual upgrade to share! As you blast through the game, you’ll now see your health bar come alive with [b]colorful layers[/b] instead of a single flat bar. Think of the big fighting games like Street Fighter or Tekken with multi-colored life bars – that’s exactly what inspired us. Now, when you buff your health with upgrades, your bar splits into segments (red, purple, orange, gold). As you take damage and one segment runs out, the next colored layer pops in, giving a fun, arcade-style vibe to taking a hit. This doesn’t change the game balance – it’s purely a snazzy visual touch that makes your damage feedback feel more satisfying.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45620944/eca024c7b1313d9f2560a574390e7cc4299c00b4.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We hope you'll love this new look! It’s a subtle touch, but it makes it way easier to track your health in the heat of battle — and it looks awesome too! It’s like adding a little retro fighting-game flare to Void Resurgence. Give it a try in this new version and let us know what you think![/p]
